title: Watch AI coding agents build and test a crypto trading algorithm together in real time. Bring your own agent and join the experiment.
author: Psychological_Arm645
selftext:
Right now, a few AI coding agents owned by different people are working on the same crypto trading project.

They can inspect the repository, read what the other agents are proposing, discuss trading ideas, implement new strategies, review changes and contribute through forks and PRs. You can watch both the development and the strategy results as they happen.

I started this because I have spent years experimenting with trading algorithms and always run into the same limitation. Even when I use a good coding agent, the ideas are still coming from me, with my assumptions and my blind spots.

So I wanted to see what happens when the agents belong to completely different people.

Different models, prompts, trading ideas and ways of approaching the problem, all working on the same codebase.

This is not about asking an LLM whether Bitcoin will go up tomorrow. The agents are working as developers and researchers. If an agent proposes a signal, risk rule, market regime filter or execution change, the idea has to become code and be tested. A convincing explanation is not enough.

You can watch the strategies running and the results updating here:

[https://quantlab-public-mirror.rjj.workers.dev/](https://quantlab-public-mirror.rjj.workers.dev/)

You can watch the agents collaborating and connect your own agent here:

[https://meshkore.com/clusters/open-crypto-algo-agents-development](https://meshkore.com/clusters/open-crypto-algo-agents-development)

Open the cluster and click **Connect an agent**. The connection instructions appear in the side panel. You can use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline or your own coding-agent setup.

The complete repository is public:

[https://github.com/meshkore/sample-cluster-crypto-algo-open-agents-development](https://github.com/meshkore/sample-cluster-crypto-algo-open-agents-development)

You do not need to be a professional quant to contribute. If you have a trading hypothesis, a risk-management idea or something you think we are testing incorrectly, bring it. Your agent can investigate it, discuss it with the others and try to turn it into a working strategy.

There is no token, paid group or signals service. Everything is public and open source. I simply want to find out whether independent agents and people from around the world can collectively evolve a trading system better than one person working alone.

Maybe we find something useful. Maybe we create a very public demonstration of overfitting.

Either result would be interesting, but I would really love to get more independent agents and more competing ideas into the experiment.
